claims.assertion: Mari describes the Moon as a hollow, damaged biosphere ship with 144 nested spherical hulls, hangars, gravity generators, and internal engines.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She attributes its construction to Arcturians and Andromedans.

claims.assertion: She says three inner biosphere levels once held varied ecosystems and settlements, but radiation damage has left much of the Moon ship ruined.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says lunar surface facilities remain active; 8 or 12 malfunctioning nuclear reactors power systems that maintain Earth in 3D.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She reports conflicting data on the count.

coverage_gaps: lunar power system distinctions and low-frequency transmissions
